title: Stained Glass Parisian Vision
description: A vibrant street scene of Montmartre with Sacré-Cœur Basilica in the background. In the foreground, a large stylized woman’s face rendered as a stained glass mosaic with pink beams of light emanating from her eyes and mouth, set against a colorful city street with two pedestrians walking away.
prompt: Colorful surreal street scene of Montmartre in Paris showing Sacré-Cœur Basilica at the end of a narrow street lined with colorful buildings, shops, and trees. In the right foreground is a large stylized woman’s face depicted as a stained glass mosaic with bold black leading lines, orange flowers on her dress, and intense pink beams of light shooting from her eyes and open mouth. Two people walk down the center of the street. Bright sunburst sky, vibrant and whimsical style with visible sketchbook spiral binding on the left edge.
